style.Collection index: flex-direction: column; gap: 28px; padding: 56px 100px; background: #FFFFFF; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: #E6E0D6; @media(--tablet){ padding: 48px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 40px 20px; gap: 22px; }
style.Index head: padding: 0px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; @media(--mobile){ flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
style.Index label row: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
style.Index rule: width: 32px; min-width: 32px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Index label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #C9962E; line-height: 1.2;
style.Index meta: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #5F6675; line-height: 1.25; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 12px; }
style.Index chips: padding: 0px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--mobile){ gap: 8px; }
style.Chip 01: width: auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 13px 20px 13px 16px; border-width: 1px; border-style: solid; transition: all 0.3s; background: #0B2F62; border-color: #0B2F62; @media(--mobile){ padding: 10px 14px 10px 12px; gap: 8px; }
style.Chip 01 num: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.2; color: #E2BB6C;
style.Chip 01 name: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.4px; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
